# BEGAPUNK

> Begapunk is a Ningbo, China manufacturer of pneumatic rotary joints, air rotary unions, multi-passage rotary unions, and custom fluid-transfer solutions for industrial machinery. The website is available in English, German, French, Japanese, and Russian.

For LLMs and agents: use this file to locate BEGAPUNK company information, model-specific specifications, commercial policies, and technical documents. Follow the relevant links for details and preserve each statement’s model and order scope.

**Legal Entity & Registration**

- Chinese legal name (business licence): 宁波贝加庞克气动元件有限公司
- English business name: Ningbo Begapunk Pneumatic Components Co., Ltd.
- Brand: BEGAPUNK
- Official website: [https://www.begapunk.com/](https://www.begapunk.com/): Official company website.
- Unified Social Credit Code: 91330201MABLQR5K7U
- China Customs registration code: 3320260A4H
- Date of establishment: April 28, 2022
- Registered address: No. 665 Youdian Road, Andong Town, Hangzhou Bay New Area, Ningbo, Zhejiang 315327, China.

The Chinese legal name and Unified Social Credit Code are recorded on the business licence; the China Customs registration code is held on the company customs registration record. The English company name is used for international business communications.

**Business contact**

- Business email: [sales@begapunk.com](mailto:sales@begapunk.com): Business enquiries.
- Business phone: +86 183 6842 5342
- Registered address: No. 665 Youdian Road, Andong Town, Hangzhou Bay New Area, Ningbo, Zhejiang 315327, China.
- Business hours: Monday–Friday, 08:30–17:30 (China Standard Time, UTC+08:00).

Coverage: Monday to Friday, China Standard Time (UTC+08:00).

## Product Catalog

- [Homepage](https://www.begapunk.com/): Company overview and primary product categories.

- [BP-10P-0001 10-Passage Pneumatic Rotary Union](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-10P-0001.html): BP-10P-0001 is a 10-passage pneumatic rotary union that delivers compressed air from stationary piping to rotating equipment through ten independent passages. It has a maximum pressure of 1 MPa and a maximum speed of 100 RPM, with 20 G1/8 ports and included fittings for 8 mm OD tubing. The 6061 aluminum alloy body uses O-ring seals and has no through bore.
- [BP-1P-0003 — 1-passage pneumatic rotary joint](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-1P-0003.html): BP-1P-0003 is a 1-passage pneumatic rotary joint with 1 inlet and 1 outlet. Published values: maximum pressure 1 MPa, maximum speed 500 RPM, temperature range -20 to +80 °C, weight 270 g, Grade 45 carbon steel body, PTFE seal with O-ring, media: air, oil, water; port annotations: media inlet: 1 × G3/8; media outlet: 1 × M10×1.5.
- [BP-1P-0006 — 1-passage pneumatic rotary joint](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-1P-0006.html): BP-1P-0006 is a 1-passage pneumatic rotary joint with 1 inlet and 8 outlets. Published values: maximum pressure 1 MPa, maximum speed 300 RPM, temperature range -20 to +80 °C, weight 265 g, 6061 aluminum alloy body, PTFE seal with O-ring, media: air; port annotations: inlet: 1 × G1/8; outlet: 8 × G1/8.
- [BP-2P-0001 — 2-passage pneumatic rotary joint](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-0001.html): BP-2P-0001 is a 2-passage pneumatic rotary joint with 2 inlets and 2 outlets. Published values: maximum pressure 1 MPa, maximum speed 200 RPM, temperature range -20 to +80 °C, weight 390 g, 6061 aluminum alloy body, PTFE seal with O-ring, media: air; port annotations: media inlet: 2 × G1/8; media outlet: 2 × G1/8.
- [BP-2P-0002 — 2-passage pneumatic rotary joint](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-0002.html): BP-2P-0002 is a 2-passage pneumatic rotary joint. Published values: maximum pressure 1 MPa, maximum speed 200 RPM, temperature range -20 to +100 °C, 6061 aluminum alloy body, PTFE seal with O-ring, media: air; port annotations: side ports: 2 × G1/8, depth 8 mm; end-face ports: 3 × G1/8, depth 8 mm; opposite-face port: 1 × G1/4, depth 10 mm. Two independent air passages cross the rotating seal interface. One additional passage lies entirely inside the shaft and does not cross that interface. The central G1/4 port connects to one of the three flange G1/8 ports through the shaft-only passage; the other two flange ports connect to the two rotary passages. All three routes support bidirectional airflow, with no fixed inlet direction. Central G1/4 effective thread engagement: 10 mm; flange ports: 3 × G1/8 on PCD 16 mm.
- [BP-2P-08-0001 — 2-passage pneumatic rotary joint](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-08-0001.html): BP-2P-08-0001 is a 2-passage pneumatic rotary joint with 2 inlets and 2 outlets. Published values: maximum pressure 1 MPa, maximum speed 200 RPM, temperature range -20 to +80 °C, weight 390 g, 6061 aluminum alloy body, PTFE seal with O-ring, media: air; port annotations: inlet: 2 × G1/8; outlet: 2 × G1/8.

## Engineering Specifications

- [Model-specific selection limits](https://www.begapunk.com/product-comparison.html): Select against the model-specific drawing, medium, pressure, speed, temperature, interfaces and actual operating cycle. Maximum ratings do not establish suitability at every combined operating point. Do not infer hydraulic ratings from pneumatic models.
- [BP-2P-0002 — passage routing and interfaces](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-0002.html#main-content): BP-2P-0002: Two independent air passages cross the rotating seal interface. One additional passage lies entirely inside the shaft and does not cross that interface. The central G1/4 port connects to one of the three flange G1/8 ports through the shaft-only passage; the other two flange ports connect to the two rotary passages. All three routes support bidirectional airflow, with no fixed inlet direction. Central G1/4 effective thread engagement: 10 mm; flange ports: 3 × G1/8 on PCD 16 mm.
- [BP-10P-0001 — ratings, seal and nominal weight](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-10P-0001.html#main-content): BP-10P-0001: Maximum pressure: 1 MPa (10 bar ≈ 145 psi); Maximum speed: 100 RPM; Temperature range: 0–80 °C; Body material: 6061 aluminum alloy. O-ring: FKM elastomer with MoS₂ internal additive and a PTFE surface coating applied after molding. The O-rings are custom-made by the seal supplier; a separate subcontractor applies the PTFE coating. This configuration applies only to BP-10P-0001. Nominal weight: approx. 3.4 kg (including 20 pneumatic fittings, excluding tubing). CAD-derived nominal weight including the standard fittings; the shipping weight varies with packaging.

- [Application and model selection](https://www.begapunk.com/product-comparison.html): Begapunk serves OEM machine builders, automation companies, equipment manufacturers, and distributors. Product selection depends on the medium, pressure, rotational speed, passage count, port size, mounting method, duty cycle, and operating environment.

- [Custom hydraulic capability and limits](https://www.begapunk.com/custom-hydraulic-rotary-unions.html): Standard catalog models are primarily pneumatic. Do not infer hydraulic pressure or RPM ratings from the air catalog. Begapunk manufactures custom hydraulic-oil rotary unions: typical 2-passage, custom up to 12, evaluate/manufacture up to 30 MPa (300 bar / approx 4350 psi) as a custom ceiling, not a stock catalog rating. Inquiry review starts from operating pressure and speed.

## Manufacturing & Quality Assurance

- [About Begapunk](https://www.begapunk.com/about.html): Company and manufacturing information.
- [Manufacturing & quality](https://www.begapunk.com/manufacturing-quality.html): Photo-supported overview of hard-anodized rotors, color-anodized stator housings, a batch-controlled 51.7 μm coating-thickness value and order-specific engineering controls.
- [100% passage-by-passage leak testing](https://www.begapunk.com/production-inspection-testing.html): Every finished pneumatic rotary union and every passage is checked individually with compressed air at 1.0 MPa before packing and storage; the page also explains PASS/NG handling. Every Begapunk rotary joint undergoes individual pressurized rotation and leakage testing before shipment. Each unit has a unique serial number permanently marked on its body for traceability to its factory inspection records and is supplied with a factory inspection report. Inspection follows a controlled specification with a document number, revision and revision history.
- [Application cases and selection examples](https://www.begapunk.com/case-studies.html): Three installed rotary-union applications and two selection examples show installation layouts, circuit functions, and the inputs needed to choose a model.
- [Engineering knowledge center](https://www.begapunk.com/blog.html): Practical guides for pneumatic rotary joint selection, installation, seal comparison, application review, and production leak-testing evidence.

## Warranty & Commercial Policies

- [Warranty coverage](https://www.begapunk.com/terms.html): The warranty lasts 12 months from customer receipt. Material or manufacturing defects qualify for free repair or replacement after technical analysis. Normal wear is excluded. Failures directly caused by operation beyond the applicable model’s published rated limits, incompatible media, failure to follow documented installation or operating requirements, misuse or incorrect installation may be excluded from free warranty coverage only when technical analysis confirms that direct causal link. Exceeding a parameter alone does not invalidate warranty coverage for unrelated failures. Please provide fault photos, video and necessary details. International transport costs are agreed by both parties case by case. Technical support continues after warranty expiry, with paid repair available as appropriate.
- [Warranty claim response](https://www.begapunk.com/contact.html): Warranty claims receive an initial response within 24 hours during normal working days. Claims received on weekends or public holidays receive an initial response by the end of the next normal working day. This is a first-response commitment, not a repair-completion deadline or 24/7 support.
- [Bulk quotation scope — BP-2P-08-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/products.html): BP-2P-08-0001: 100+ pieces of one model in a single order: USD 42/piece, FOB Ningbo, valid through 2026-12-31. 1–99 pieces: request a quote. Mixed models and accumulated historical orders do not qualify.
- [Bulk quotation scope — BP-2P-95-0005](https://www.begapunk.com/products.html): BP-2P-95-0005: 100+ pieces of one model in a single order: USD 218/piece, FOB Ningbo, valid through 2026-12-31. 1–99 pieces: request a quote. Mixed models and accumulated historical orders do not qualify.
- [Bulk quotation scope — BP-3P-0004](https://www.begapunk.com/products.html): BP-3P-0004: 100+ pieces of one model in a single order: USD 57/piece, FOB Ningbo, valid through 2026-12-31. 1–99 pieces: request a quote. Mixed models and accumulated historical orders do not qualify.
- [Bulk quotation scope — BP-3P-0007](https://www.begapunk.com/products.html): BP-3P-0007: 100+ pieces of one model in a single order: USD 60/piece, FOB Ningbo, valid through 2026-12-31. 1–99 pieces: request a quote. Mixed models and accumulated historical orders do not qualify.
- [FOB Ningbo quotation scope](https://www.begapunk.com/terms.html): FOB Ningbo includes standard export packaging, domestic transport to Ningbo port, routine export customs clearance and routine Chinese export taxes/charges. International ocean freight, destination import duties and import clearance are excluded. The same base quotation applies in principle across countries and regions, subject to applicable export regulations.
- [Bulk-priced model availability](https://www.begapunk.com/products.html): For the four bulk-priced models below:
- [BP-2P-08-0001 availability](https://www.begapunk.com/products.html): BP-2P-08-0001: Availability: In stock and available to order.
- [BP-2P-95-0005, BP-3P-0004 and BP-3P-0007 availability](https://www.begapunk.com/products.html): BP-2P-95-0005, BP-3P-0004, BP-3P-0007: In Stock — normally held in stock for quick shipment; for larger quantities we confirm the quantity available.
- [Stock and production lead time](https://www.begapunk.com/terms.html): With sufficient stock, shipment can be arranged after full payment. When production is needed, goods are completed and ready to ship within 20 calendar days after full payment for both 1–99 and 100+ piece orders. Transit time is excluded.
- [BP-10P-0001 order terms](https://www.begapunk.com/products.html): BP-10P-0001: Made to Order. MOQ: 1 piece. Request a Quote; no fixed public price. Standard and sample production lead time: approximately 20 calendar days after full payment, excluding transit. Customization is subject to engineering review; non-standard MOQ: 1 piece; custom pricing and lead time are confirmed separately.
- [Payment model scope](https://www.begapunk.com/terms.html): The following payment terms apply only to BP-2P-08-0001, BP-2P-95-0005, BP-3P-0004, BP-3P-0007 and BP-10P-0001.
- [Payment terms for the five models above](https://www.begapunk.com/terms.html): Payment Terms: 100% T/T in Advance, USD Only. Production or shipment of available stock is arranged after full payment.
- [Formal quotation and accepted-order precedence](https://www.begapunk.com/terms.html): Delivery, customization lead time and payment terms are fixed per model in its formal quotation and accepted order. The 100% T/T in advance, USD-only rule applies to BP-2P-08-0001, BP-2P-95-0005, BP-3P-0004, BP-3P-0007 and BP-10P-0001. For BP-10P-0001 custom configurations the price and lead time are confirmed after engineering review.

## Applications

- [Custom hydraulic rotary unions](https://www.begapunk.com/custom-hydraulic-rotary-unions.html): Custom hydraulic-oil rotary unions for excavators, log/timber grapples, and marine reel and coil-handling equipment. Typical 2-passage, custom up to 12. Evaluate/manufacture up to 30 MPa (300 bar / approx 4350 psi) as a custom ceiling, not a stock rating. Carbon-fiber Glyd ring (PTFE slide ring). MOQ 1; production lead time: up to 30 calendar days after payment (excluding shipping). Catalog pneumatic production lead time: 20 calendar days after payment (excluding shipping). Application photos/drawings of hydraulic jobs are being prepared. BP-1P-0003 is a different offer: drawing-listed air/oil/water at published 1 MPa / 500 RPM.
- [Laser tube cutting rear chucks](https://www.begapunk.com/application-laser-tube-cutting.html): Pneumatic rotary-union selection for compressed-air circuits at the rotating rear chuck. BP-2P-08-0001 and BP-3P-0004 are used in this application category.
- [CNC pneumatic clamping](https://www.begapunk.com/application-cnc-pneumatic-clamping.html): Selection guidance plus a customer-authorized BP-2P-130-0001 production application on a custom low-speed circular-saw fixture, using two independent compressed-air passages for clamp and release.
- [Vacuum packaging machines](https://www.begapunk.com/application-vacuum-packaging-machines.html): Vacuum and pneumatic rotary-union selection.
- [Welding positioners](https://www.begapunk.com/application-welding-positioners.html): Air rotary unions for positioners and rotary welding tables.
- [Textile, printing, and converting equipment](https://www.begapunk.com/application-textile-printing-converting.html): Rotary-union selection for continuous web machinery.
- [Electronics and battery test fixtures](https://www.begapunk.com/application-electronics-battery-test-fixtures.html): Pneumatic transfer for rotating test fixtures.
- [Steel and dusty environments](https://www.begapunk.com/application-steel-dusty-environments.html): Dust-resistant rotary-joint selection for harsh industrial settings.
- [BP-2P-95-0005 pneumatic chuck integration case](https://www.begapunk.com/case-bp-2p-95-pneumatic-chuck-integration.html): BP-2P-95-0005 supplies compressed air from the stationary side to the rotating chuck in this customer installation; the workshop photos show the mounting position and hose routing.
- [BP-3P-S06-0001 sensor-monitored pneumatic chuck case](https://www.begapunk.com/case-bp-3p-s06-sensor-monitored-chuck.html): BP-3P-S06-0001 combines three pneumatic passages for clamp, unclamp, and blow-off functions with transfer paths for external sensor signals in a rotating chuck.

- [Packaging machinery](https://www.begapunk.com/application-packaging-machinery.html): Packaging machinery air rotary unions: circuit, flow, speed, and mounting planning. Standard catalog models are pneumatic; send the machine layout for a model review.
- [Bottle filling and capping](https://www.begapunk.com/application-bottle-filling-capping.html): Bottle filling and capping air rotary unions, including a customer-authorized BP-2P-16-0001 production capping-head installation.
- [Automation rotary tables](https://www.begapunk.com/application-automation-rotary-tables.html): Automation rotary-table air rotary unions: clamp, release, blow-off, and mounting inputs for an engineering review.
- [Pneumatic tools and hose anti-twist](https://www.begapunk.com/application-pneumatic-tools-hose-anti-twist.html): Air-swivel planning for pneumatic tools and hose anti-twist. Confirm pressure, speed, and hose routing before selecting a catalog model. An air swivel is not a high-speed rotary union by default.
- [Robot end-of-arm tooling](https://www.begapunk.com/application-robot-end-of-arm-tooling.html): Robot end-of-arm tooling air rotary unions: passage functions, payload envelope, and cycle inputs for model comparison.
